@{5f2d1841a860ab34bc750388|full_name}: That only happens when rig of your avatar has an issue with FBT, most likely hip bone having it's end at the same height as leg bones. Before IK update it used to break your shoulder and misalign your center of view with avatar's head.
Still not fixed :( I think scale of bones doesn't being send to other players, so we getting misaligned

One thing i could drop in here is i have been tweaking my avatar almost every day for a year now, making sure that it's 1:1 tracking for my whole body, including shoulders neck and etc. It was a piece of shit and i find myself still not being satisfied with it at times. But, that happens to fix it in some ways, it almost never occurs and when it does its extremely minor, if i try other avatars then it all goes to shit. people's viewpoint being inside their neck when they are laying down but not when they are standing. And also it seems to happen more often if you use the old way of calibrating. Currently the only way to minimize it is by trying to achieve a more accurate representation of your legs, hips to chest proportions. To minimize the whole compensating that the ik does to make you fit in the avatar. Its a temporary fix. And its hella fun to have 1:1 movement lol, check it out if possible and let me know how it goes.

details:
Currently on live full body tracking is desynced from what you see locally and what everyone else in the server sees. Everything above the waist is misaligned including the face and hand locations, the attached pictures show examples.
The cause may be based on the hip tracker. If you move the hip tracker at all your viewpoint and hands move on the server side. The desync happens with both the new and old calibration methods but is new to this patch.

3 point tracking (no hip or leg trackers) seems to be unaffected.
title: FBT causes upper body desync/ misalignment locally vs server since 3.0 update
